module todo.bugs

from std.web import App, Html, Request, Response, h, redirect
from todo.app import app


@app.get("/about")
def about(req: Request) -> Html:
    """Web mistakes."""
    return h.dvi(
        h.a("Home", href="/"),
        h.a("Todos", href="/todo"),
        h.a("Docs", href="https://example.com/docs"),
        h.input(name="q", placholder="search"),
        h.div("x", klass="box"),
        h.button("Toggle", post="/todos/7/toggel"),
        h.form(h.button("Go"), action="/todos", method="get"),
        h.p(req.from_data),
    )


@app.get("/users/{user_id}")
def user(id: int) -> Html:
    """Route parameter and handler parameter disagree."""
    return h.p(str(id))


@app.get("/about")
def about_again(req: Request) -> Response:
    """Same route twice; a redirect to nowhere."""
    return redirect("/abuot")
